title: Share the meeting
description: Creates a link so whoever has it can read the meeting in a browser.
passwordHint: Whoever opens the link will have to type it. Send it some other way.
privacy: Murmur encrypts it on this Mac before sending it to your Cloudflare Worker. Without the link nobody can read it, not even Cloudflare.
privacyPassword: Murmur encrypts it on this Mac before sending it to your Cloudflare Worker. Without the link and the password nobody can read it, not even Cloudflare.
consent: It includes names and what each person said: only share it with people who may see it.
revokeMessage: It will stop working for everyone who has it.
notConnected: To share, connect Murmur to a Worker on your Cloudflare account. It's free and you only set it up once.

page.footerExpires: Shared from Murmur on {{date}}. The link expires on {{expires}}.

audioNote: The recording is the most personal part and the heaviest: only include it if needed.
consentAudio: It includes names, what each person said and their voice: only share it with people who may hear it.
